card.name: Giving words after a dose amount
card.fires_on: The words "as", "given" or "administered" right after a dose amount, just before the route or schedule (for example "as an intravenous infusion"). Seen in dosage and administration sections.

modes.label: "as" before infusion
modes.description: The word "as" follows a dose and leads into an infusion description.
modes.example: creatinine clearance (calculated by Cockcroft-Gault equation) of 45 mL/min or greater is 500 mg/m 2<< as>> an intravenous infusion over 10

modes.label: "given" or "administered" after dose
modes.description: A giving verb follows the dose and leads into the route or schedule.
modes.example: or after the sixth post-partum week. The recommended dosage of depo-subQ provera 104 is 104 mg<< given>> subcutaneously every 12 to
